name: 03-execution-lanes
title: 同一个逻辑 Agent 内部的运行分工
kind: 逻辑归属与执行机制示意
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. REDESIGN the attached illustration to correct its semantic boundary. Keep its Guizang matte ceramic/paper material style, off-white background, rich coordinated cobalt/coral/mint/yellow/lavender palette and chibi HUMANOID robot appearance. The original mistakenly shows three separate agent characters. CRITICAL CORRECTION: depict EXACTLY ONE logical Agent with ONE chibi humanoid robot mascot representing the WHOLE enclosing system, not the Supervisor alone. Supervisor and Executors are internal runtime components of that SINGLE Agent.
Landscape 16:9. Main object is a very large, CLEARLY CLOSED rounded rectangular cream ceramic enclosure with a thin cobalt outline, occupying almost the full canvas with 6% margins. Its top header says “同一个 Agent” in large black Chinese type. A small complete chibi humanoid robot with black screen face, eyes, arms/hands and short legs/feet sits on the top-left rim as the SOLE avatar for the enclosure. Put “统一身份 · 持续负责” underneath the header.
INSIDE this same enclosure:
- Left: a blue-and-cream physical control desk with clipboard and small dial, NO face/eyes/robot. Large exact label “Supervisor”, smaller label “协调与判断”.
- Middle: a compact yellow selection switch, label “按任务选模”.
- Right: TWO stacked rectangular computing trays, no faces, no limbs, clearly internal tool components. Upper coral tray label “Executor 1”, smaller “模型 A”; lower mint tray label “Executor 2”, smaller “模型 B”. Small code glyphs on trays. Shared label “按需执行” next to the right group.
- Outbound blue arrows from Supervisor through the model selector, splitting into two arrowheads pointing toward the respective Executor trays.
- Separate lavender return route from each Executor tray merges and points BACK to the Supervisor control desk; keep it visibly INSIDE the Agent enclosure. Label this shared return route “结果回传”. Direction clear, no crossing or ambiguities.
There are no other avatars and no separate agent containers. Do not draw a robot for Supervisor or any Executor. The one robot at the enclosure rim represents the entire logical Agent. All internal objects fully enclosed. No external team members. No cost numbers or performance promises. Model A/B are illustrative model options, not named vendors. Short readable labels, clean spacing, visually dominant outer identity boundary, subtle internal material relief, professional editorial technical diagram.
Exact words only: 同一个 Agent; 统一身份 · 持续负责; Supervisor; 协调与判断; 按任务选模; Executor 1; 模型 A; Executor 2; 模型 B; 按需执行; 结果回传.
Avoid three robots, avoid any suggestion of three organizational members, avoid separate identity badges for internal components. This is a logical identity boundary, not a claim of a single OS process.
correction: One logical Agent identity encloses Supervisor and Executors; one robot represents whole Agent, internal components are not separate team members.
